targetPersonas: Marketing Directors, CEOs, Export Sales Managers - All Decision Makers
messagingAngle: Direct, consultative approach focusing on interactive 3D product exploration

emails.subject: 3D product experience
emails.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Have you ever considered letting prospects explore and configure your products interactively in 3D before speaking with sales?

We build interactive 3D product experiences for manufacturers of complex physical products and equipment.

Worth sending over an example?

Best,
{{senderName}}

emails.subject: worth an example?
emails.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

The reason I asked is that complex physical products can be difficult to fully understand through photos, PDFs and technical specs alone.

Interactive 3D lets prospects explore the product, its components and different configurations directly online.

Would an example be useful?

Best,
{{senderName}}

emails.subject: 3D product experience
emails.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

One last thought - an interactive model doesn't necessarily have to cover your entire product range.

It can start with a single product or product line where visualization would be most useful.

Happy to send over an example if you'd like to see what I mean.

Best,
{{senderName}}
